description: Round 4 of the SYNTHETIC classical cseq_wave benchmark (no quantum-hardware, QEC or quantum-advantage claim). Three questions left open by round 3: (1) is the early-step accuracy peak real on held-out data and does early stopping at a fixed step chosen on separate seeds beat the 25-step default and the cue; (2) what kind of states are the spurious final states at high load; (3) how does complex128 matvec-dominated recall time depend on the BLAS thread count (1, 2, 3, 4 and default). This file and its lock are committed before benchmark_round4.py exists and before any round-4 experiment is run.
author_knowledge_at_writing: Rounds 1 to 3 are known. From round 3 (random patterns, bit-flip cues, N = 64/128/256): accuracy at steps 2 to 5 was higher than at step 25 in the cells examined and then fell to step 100 (an exploratory, not preregistered observation, made on seed 20261027 data); 397 of 400 final states at step 100 in the x-cells were farther than 0.10 from every stored pattern and its negation; 344 of 400 were fixed points and 56 were still changing bits at steps 98 to 100; complex128 timed directly to N = 14336 gave 6.8 to 8.2 s with one thread and 0.90 to 1.01 s with default (8) threads for 25 steps, threads 2 to 4 were not tested; the original claim was 2.2 to 3.5 s for N = 16384. Round 4 uses a new seed (20261028), so no round-3 trial is reused. No round-4 measurement existed when this file was written.

statistics.paired_gain: per-trial difference of two bit accuracies on the same trial (same patterns, same cue)
statistics.test: two-sided sign-flip permutation test of mean difference = 0 (add-one rule, assumes symmetry about 0 under the null), same implementation as round 3
statistics.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg at alpha = 0.05 inside each comparison family (one family per comparison, over its primary cells)
statistics.cell_verdict: higher / lower if BH-adjusted p < alpha and the mean difference is > 0 / < 0, otherwise not_significant

bootstrap.pooled: equal-weight mean over cells of the per-cell mean difference; trials resampled within each cell independently

early_step.question: Is accuracy at steps 2 to 5 reliably higher than at step 25 and at step 1, and does early stopping at the best fixed step beat the 25-step default and the cue?
early_step.dynamics: identical to round 3 (synchronous recall from HolographicMemory.finalize() weights; trajectory checked equal to mem.recall(steps=25) on every held-out trial)
early_step.pattern_kind: random (independent uniform +-1 patterns), target = first pattern, cue = target with each bit flipped independently with probability q
early_step.primary_cells: 3 N x 2 q x 3 P/N = 18 high-load cells, fixed here in advance (not chosen from data); the P/N = 1/16 contrast cells are exploratory and descriptive only

selection.purpose: choose the fixed stopping step only; no inferential statistic is computed or reported from these trials

early_step.early_statistic: a_early = mean over steps 2, 3, 4, 5 of the trial's bit accuracy to the target (one number per trial)
early_step.stop_step_selection: s_star = the candidate step with the highest equal-weight mean (over the primary cells) of selection-set bit accuracy; ties go to the smaller step. Exploratory secondary: s_star_c chosen the same way inside each cell.

comparisons.E2a_stop_vs_step25: accuracy at s_star minus accuracy at step 25
comparisons.E2b_stop_vs_cue: accuracy at s_star minus cue accuracy (step 0)

verdict_rule.supported: cells_higher >= ceil(0.75 * n_cells) AND pooled 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 AND pooled mean difference >= 0.01
verdict_rule.rejected: cells_higher <= floor(0.25 * n_cells) OR pooled 95% bootstrap CI upper bound <= 0

early_step.verdict_rule_note: cells_higher = number of primary cells with cell verdict 'higher' in that comparison; n_cells = 18 in the full profile. Each of the four comparisons gets its own verdict word; there is no combined verdict.
reported: per comparison: cells higher / not_significant / lower, pooled mean difference with 95% CI, per-cell means and BH p
held-out mean accuracy by step 0 to 25 for every primary cell (descriptive)
contrast-cell comparisons (descriptive counts only, no verdict)
s_star_c per cell and its held-out gain over step 25 (exploratory)

spurious_states.question: What kind of states does the dynamics end in at high load?
spurious_states.pattern_kind: random; cue = target with bit flips at probability q; final state = bits at step 100

definitions.overlap: m_mu = (xi_mu . x) / N with xi = 1 - 2*bits (+-1 form) of stored pattern mu and x the final state; a_mu = |m_mu|; nearest stored sign-symmetric distance = (1 - max a_mu) / 2
definitions.stored: max a_mu >= 1 - 2*tau_stored, i.e. within tau_stored of some stored pattern or its negation; subtypes: target or other, positive (m > 0) or negative (m < 0)
definitions.mixture_k: for k = 3 then k = 5: take the k stored patterns with the largest a_mu, s_mu = sign(m_mu), M_k = sign(sum over those k of s_mu * xi_mu) (k odd, no ties); mixture_k if the normalised Hamming distance between x and M_k is <= tau_mixture
definitions.partial_overlap: not stored, not mixture_3, not mixture_5, and max a_mu >= 0.5
definitions.precedence: stored, mixture_3, mixture_5, partial_overlap, unstructured (first match)
definitions.non_stored: every final state that is not 'stored'
definitions.dynamics: fixed_point / period_2 / still_moving exactly as in round 3 (bits at steps 98, 99, 100)
definitions.mean_direction_cosine: |x . S| / (sqrt(N) * ||S||) with S = sum over stored patterns of xi_mu (real); the null is a uniformly random +-1 state against the same patterns
definitions.energy_per_bit: -(x . W_real x) / (2 N) with W the finalized coupling matrix (real part); reported for final states and for the stored patterns (descriptive)

harness_checks.positive_controls: per trial: (i) a stored pattern with 5% random bit flips must be 'stored'; (ii) an exact sign-sum of 3 randomly chosen stored patterns with 5% flips must be 'mixture_3'; (iii) the same with 5 patterns must be 'mixture_5' or 'mixture_3' (reported as rates, no pass criterion); (iv) a uniformly random +-1 state (null) is classified and the rates reported
harness_checks.validity: the harness is reported valid if the (i) and (ii) rates are >= 0.95 and the null rate of 'stored' or 'mixture' is <= 0.05; otherwise the Sp1 to Sp3 verdicts are reported 'harness_invalid'

Sp1_mixture_states.claim: most non-stored final states are mixture_3 or mixture_5 states
Sp1_mixture_states.measure: pooled fraction of non-stored final states labelled mixture_3 or mixture_5; Wilson 95%

Sp2_unstructured.claim: most non-stored final states have no large overlap with any stored pattern

Sp3_partial_overlap.claim: most non-stored final states keep a large overlap (>= 0.5) with some stored pattern without being a mixture

Sp4_fixed_points.claim: non-stored final states are fixed points of the dynamics
Sp4_fixed_points.measure: pooled fraction of non-stored final states with dynamics class fixed_point; Wilson 95%

Sp5_mean_direction.claim: non-stored final states lean toward the mean of the stored patterns
Sp5_mean_direction.measure: per-trial paired difference (mean_direction_cosine of the final state minus that of the random null state), pooled over non-stored trials, bootstrap 95% CI of the mean
Sp5_mean_direction.supported: CI lower bound > 0 and mean difference >= 0.10

spurious_states.note: Sp1 to Sp3 are mutually exclusive and exhaustive over non-stored states, so at most one can be supported. Per-q and per-P/N breakdowns are descriptive.

threads.question: How does the time of a 25-step complex128 recall depend on the BLAS thread count?
threads.extension_note: 8192 is an addition to the sizes requested (2048, 4096), declared here before any measurement, so that the round-3 N = 8192 values and a scaling estimate for 16384 can be compared; it does not replace the requested sizes
threads.reference_mode: default (no thread environment variable set; 8 logical CPUs on this VM)
threads.how_set: a fresh subprocess per (run, mode) with OMP_NUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS, MKL_NUM_THREADS, VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS, NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS all set to k
threads.build: chunked 64 MiB-row dense matrix from 8 random BPSK patterns, diagonal zeroed (round-3 builder, 16 N^2 bytes); memory rule as round 3 (peak <= 4 GiB and <= 0.5 MemAvailable, 300 s wait)
threads.thread_effect_check: for each (run, mode, N) one extra recall is timed with process CPU time and wall time; cpu_over_wall is reported (about k expected when k threads are in use). A mode whose cpu_over_wall at k >= 2 is below 1.3 at N >= 4096 is flagged 'thread setting may not have taken effect'.

statistics.per_cell: median recall seconds with bootstrap 95% CI of the median over the repeats
statistics.speedup: t(k=1) / t(k) within the same run, 95% bootstrap CI (the two repeat sets resampled independently); efficiency = speedup / k

T1_speedup.claim: more threads make the recall faster
T1_speedup.unit: each (run, N, k) with k in 2, 3, 4
T1_speedup.supported: the speedup CI lower bound is > 1.10 in >= 80% of the units

T2_monotone.claim: time falls monotonically from 1 to 4 threads
T2_monotone.unit: each (run, N): median time strictly decreasing over k = 1, 2, 3, 4
T2_monotone.supported: >= 5 of the 6 (or all units if fewer in quick mode, rounded up at 80%)

T3_repeatability.unit: each (N, k incl. default): ratio of the two run medians within [0.8, 1.25]

T4_original_claim.claim: with at most 4 threads the original claim (recall at N = 16384 in 2.2 to 3.5 s) is reachable
T4_original_claim.estimate: EXTRAPOLATED, NOT MEASURED: t16384(k) = t(8192) * t(8192) / t(4096) per run and mode (one more doubling at the measured 4096 to 8192 ratio)
T4_original_claim.supported: for some k in 2, 3, 4 the estimate is <= 3.5 s in both runs
T4_original_claim.rejected: for every k in 1 to 4 the estimate is > 3.5 s in both runs
T4_original_claim.note: complex128 at N = 16384 (4 GiB) is not measured, now or in round 4

determinism.hash_scope: protocol hash, profile, seed, early-step results (held-out and selection), spurious-state results, the threads plan; excludes every timing, load measurement, memory decision, CPU/wall measurement and everything derived from them
determinism.ci: quick mode is run twice in CI and the deterministic_sha256 lines are diffed; full mode is manual only

must_report: every hypothesis with its verdict word and the numbers behind it
held-out numbers only for the early-step questions
the selected stopping step and how it was chosen
harness checks (positive controls, null rates, trajectory mismatches)
thread-effect check values and discarded or uncontrolled timing batches
reporting.wording: synthetic classical software; no quantum-hardware, QEC or quantum-advantage claim; timings are for this machine and this load
